item.title: National Weather Service issues Red Flag warning for the Ozarks
item.description: The National Weather Service Office in Springfield has issued a Red Flag Warning for the Ozarks due to high winds and low humidity, causing dry conditions and critical fire danger for the region.

item.title: 70-year-old dies in Boone County, Arkansas three-vehicle crash
item.description: BOONE COUNTY, Ark. — A 70-year-old man has died after a three-vehicle crash in Boone County, Arkansas, on Monday, Feb. 16. item.title: Windy and warm weather Thursday comes with a heightened fire danger
item.description: Temperatures climbed above 70° in most areas, with a Red Flag Warning issued due to high fire danger, before cooler weather and a round of late winter cold arrive on Friday.

item.title: Missouri State University proposing $50 graduation application fee
item.description: Missouri State's Board of Governors is expected to vote on a proposal to require graduating seniors to pay a $50 graduation application fee, which would take effect for graduates in the 2026-2027 school year.
